name: Cenes de la Vega (Spain)
description: Divided by a blue diagonal band fimbriated white from the lower hoist to the upper fly, red at the hoist with a yellow pomegranate and green at the fly.
history: Cenes de la Vega adopted its arms and flag officially on 9 May 2008; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of a blue diagonal edged white from the lower hoist corner to the upper fly, the hoist triangle red with a yellow pomegranate and the fly triangle green; the pomegranate represents Granada, the blue stripe the waters of the Genil and the red and green the colours of the flag of Andalusia.

features.role: band edged white from the lower hoist to the upper fly
